name: exploded-portafilter-pareto-26.10-preview-s1-r5
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of an espresso machine portafilter, as an SVG. Use a double-spout portafilter with a removable basket rather than a bottomless one.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1000" height="1300" viewBox="0 0 1000 1300">
<defs>
 <linearGradient id="steel"><stop stop-color="#737f85"/><stop offset=".18" stop-color="#e9eff0"/><stop offset=".4" stop-color="#b9c5c9"/><stop offset=".65" stop-color="#7b8b93"/><stop offset=".85" stop-color="#d4dfe2"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#99a7ad"/></linearGradient>
 <linearGradient id="top" x2="0" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#f8fbfc"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#acbcc3"/></linearGradient>
 <linearGradient id="inside" x2="0" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#293b45"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#94a8b1"/></linearGradient>
 <linearGradient id="wood" x2="0" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#ac784a"/><stop offset=".32" stop-color="#81532f"/><stop offset=".8" stop-color="#52341e"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#38281c"/></linearGradient>
 <pattern id="holes" width="11" height="8" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><ellipse cx="4" cy="4" rx="1.6" ry="1.1" fill="#344a55"/></pattern>
 <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" refX="6" refY="4" orient="auto"><path d="M1 1 6 4 1 7" fill="none" stroke="#aa663c" stroke-width="1.2"/></marker>
</defs>
<rect width="1000" height="1300" fill="#f6f3ec"/>
<g font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" fill="#263c46">
 <text x="60" y="63" font-size="12" letter-spacing="3" fill="#a4663f">COMPONENT STUDY / 01</text>
 <text x="60" y="110" font-size="35" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="1">The espresso portafilter</text>
 <text x="61" y="140" font-size="15" fill="#61727a">Exploded assembly · removable basket · double-spout outlet</text>
 <path d="M60 166H940" stroke="#c9cec9"/>
 <text x="940" y="64" text-anchor="end" font-size="11" letter-spacing="2">SCHEMATIC • NOT TO SCALE</text>
</g>
<!-- The vertical axis belongs only to basket, spring, head and outlet. -->
<path d="M550 205V1100" fill="none" stroke="#b4bcb9" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="12 6 3 6"/>

<g stroke="#607781" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linejoin="round">

 <path d="M414 321 L431 376" fill="none" stroke="#f0f5f6" stroke-width="2"/>
</g>

<path d="M523 526 C465 524 411 511 411 492 C411 470 473 453 550 453 S689 470 689 492 C689 509 637 524 577 526" fill="none" stroke="#4e626c" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>

 <!-- shallow elliptical groove and closed collection floor -->
 <ellipse cx="550" cy="653" rx="145" ry="39" fill="none" stroke="#c2cdd0"/>

</g>

<path d="M175 828 L370 757" stroke="#aa663c" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="6 5"/>

 <path d="M-22 -8 H8 V8 H-22" fill="url(#steel)" stroke="#607781"/>
 <path d="M-17 -8 L-14 8 M-10 -8 L-7 8 M-3 -8 L0 8 M4 -8 L7 8" fill="none" stroke="#607781"/>
</g>
<!-- detached double-spout fitting, with a shared threaded inlet -->
<path d="M550 911 V870" stroke="#aa663c" stroke-width="1.7" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
<g stroke="#607781" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linejoin="round">
 <path d="M514 936 V959 C502 974 458 975 443 993 C434 1005 433 1021 433 1032 Q454 1044 475 1032 V1016 C475 1009 523 1005 550 986 C577 1005 625 1009 625 1016 V1032 Q646 1044 667 1032 C667 1015 666 1005 657 993 C642 975 598 974 586 959 V936Z" fill="url(#steel)"/>

 <ellipse cx="550" cy="936" rx="24" ry="9" fill="#344b56"/>

 <path d="M520 959 C515 980 457 981 448 999" fill="none" stroke="#f5f8f9" stroke-width="3"/>
 <ellipse cx="454" cy="1032" rx="21" ry="8" fill="url(#top)"/>
 <ellipse cx="454" cy="1032" rx="14" ry="4.5" fill="#263c46" stroke="none"/>
 <ellipse cx="646" cy="1032" rx="21" ry="8" fill="url(#top)"/>
 <ellipse cx="646" cy="1032" rx="14" ry="4.5" fill="#263c46" stroke="none"/>
</g>

<path d="M550 423 V442 M550 542 V580" fill="none" stroke="#aa663c" stroke-width="1.7" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
<!-- leaders -->
<g fill="none" stroke="#7b8b91" stroke-width="1.2">
 <path d="M700 287 H749"/><path d="M690 490 H749"/><path d="M716 739 H749"/>

<g font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
 <g fill="#263c46">
  <circle cx="768" cy="287" r="14"/><circle cx="768" cy="490" r="14"/><circle cx="768" cy="739" r="14"/><circle cx="98" cy="917" r="14"/><circle cx="768" cy="996" r="14"/>
 </g>
 <g fill="white" font-size="12" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle">
  <text x="768" y="291">1</text><text x="768" y="494">2</text><text x="768" y="743">3</text><text x="98" y="921">4</text><text x="768" y="1000">5</text>
 </g>
 <g fill="#263c46" font-size="14" font-weight="700">
  <text x="793" y="281">FILTER BASKET</text><text x="793" y="484">RETAINING SPRING</text><text x="793" y="733">PORTAFILTER BODY</text><text x="80" y="952">HANDLE + FERRULE</text><text x="793" y="990">DOUBLE SPOUT</text>
 </g>
 <g fill="#61727a" font-size="12.5">
  <text x="793" y="303">Removable stainless steel</text><text x="793" y="322">Perforated filter floor</text>
  <text x="793" y="506">Split wire basket clip</text><text x="793" y="525">Seats in internal groove</text>
  <text x="793" y="755">Chrome-plated brass</text><text x="793" y="774">Closed collection sump</text>
  <text x="80" y="974">Walnut grip · threaded side mount</text>
  <text x="793" y="1012">Screw-on outlet fitting</text><text x="793" y="1031">Two separate discharge lips</text>
  <text x="259" y="594">Group-locking lug</text>
 </g>
</g>
<path d="M60 1134 H940" stroke="#c9cec9"/>
<g font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
 <text x="60" y="1170" font-size="12" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="2" fill="#a4663f">ASSEMBLY NOTES</text>
 <text x="60" y="1199" font-size="14" fill="#526770">The spring seats inside the head; the basket presses past it and rests on the upper rim.</text>
 <text x="60" y="1223" font-size="14" fill="#526770">The handle threads into the side boss. The double-spout fitting threads onto the bottom outlet.</text>
 <text x="60" y="1268" font-size="11" fill="#82908f" letter-spacing="1">ILLUSTRATIVE GEOMETRY · EXPLODED SPACING · NO BOTTOMLESS OPENING</text>
</g>
</svg>
